description: Translate an i18n locale JSON object to one or more target languages, preserving structure and placeholders. Requires your own LLM key (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY/OPENAI_API_KEY). For key-free work use the validation tools. Legacy: the MCP client's model via sampling.

content.description: The source locale as a JSON string, e.g. {"greeting":"Hello {{name}}"}

provider.description: Force a provider: anthropic or openai. Omit to auto-detect from the environment.

name: translate_json
title: Translate JSON
